apply_patch_asyncio_nested_loops: apply patch to asyncio to make its event loop reentrant for nested event loop usage
run_asyncio_coroutine: run an asyncio coroutine with nested event loop support and optional debug mode
patch_loop_reentrant: patch an asyncio event loop to allow nested run_until_complete and run_forever calls
patch_policy_new_loop: patch the asyncio event loop policy to return patched loops on creation
patch_tornado_future: patch tornado concurrent module to use pure-Python asyncio Future when tornado is already imported
